svg.title: GridPulse architecture: Azure and Microsoft Fabric, Germany West Central
svg.text: GridPulse: data platform architecture (Azure + Microsoft Fabric)
Region: Germany West Central for every resource. Status 2026-11-22: code tested locally; in the cloud only rg-hz2611-cdda and its budget exist, all other items are not created yet.
hourly Ontario demand, CSV over HTTP
Germany West Central · Azure for Students
Microsoft Fabric workspace ws_gridpulse·Nacir's 60-day trial capacity FTL4 (4 CU)·Germany West Central·not created yet
demo rate about 10 events/s on FTL4
ts, meter_id, site_id, kw, voltage, status
Q1 kWh per site, 5-min tumbling window
Q2 site load above its 1 h mean + 3 sd
Q3 top 5 sites over the last 15 min
tiles from Q1, Q2, Q3, auto-refresh
Q2 returns rows → alert mail to the team
all years, full refresh, then nb_forecast
stops before overwriting silver on FAIL
same code tested locally on Spark 3.5
Direct Lake on the gold tables
star schema on date_key, DAX measures
KPIs: peak MW, energy GWh, MAPE %
abnormal sites on rtd_gridpulse + alert mail
notebooks, KQL, SQL, IaC; Fabric Git sync or fab export
Security and governance (applies to every layer; Key Vault, Policy and the budget are in the RG on the left)
Microsoft Entra ID (UIR tenant): 3 personas, least privilege
subscription Owner, Key Vault Administrator, SQL Entra admin,
RG Contributor + Resource Policy Contributor, Key Vault Secrets Officer,
RG Reader, no Key Vault access, workspace Viewer,
sees gold only through sm_gridpulse (no PII)
bronze_customers: only PII table in lake
silver, gold: salted SHA-256 hash only
labels only if the tenant has them
Purview scan of Azure SQL + OneLake:
at rest: TDE on Azure SQL, Fabric
in transit: TLS 1.2 minimum on SQL,
HTTPS and AMQP over TLS elsewhere
